This is a planning shell for a future lab using one actual classroom computer. The teacher will add the computer photograph, exterior PSU nameplate photograph, approved measurement method, and actual values before release.

::: {.tejwarning title="Safety boundary"}
Keep the computer powered off and unplugged while identifying parts. Never open the PSU or probe energized circuits. Future power readings must use a teacher-approved external wall power meter or verified manufacturer data.
:::
